name: acceptance-gate
description: Codex-native acceptance gate for AI-generated features with contracts, evals, evidence, decision cards, gate decision skills (approve/signoff), a gate metrics report, runtime hooks, CI re-checks, and a coverage-scan skill (morphological-scan) feeding the contract Coverage section, and a Gate-1 gap-probe block (clean-context critique, fail-visible flags). v1.22 adds the rules ledger to pre-merge-check.sh: clean must be PROVEN — every rule block records ran/declared-off through one ledger_mark chokepoint against a fixed EXPECTED list, a machine-readable summary line whose expected count is derived from EXPECTED rather than from the running totals, and any ledger mismatch is an internal-gate error (exit 2). v1.22.1 hardening wave: declared-but-unusable scope/filter values now exit 2 as a class (empty --base/--slug, typo'd or /-containing slug filters, PRE_MERGE_BASE set-but-empty with +x set-detection, declared base on a git-less root), an explicit --base still overrides an empty env var, VIOLATION [scope] prints on stdout like every other VIOLATION. (Repo-internal maintenance tooling also hardened — sync-plugin-packages.sh rejects extra argv — but that script ships only in the kit repo, not in this package.) v1.23 renders the Gate-2 "Ngoài hợp đồng" block on the decision card: real defects that fall outside the approved scope are shown as human work with three explicit choices (known limits / new contract / widen scope), plus the coverage-cluster flag; a review-findings.md without those sections renders exactly as before.

interface.longDescription: Turn feature requests into acceptance contracts, generate evals, render decision artifacts, verify machine evidence, and block unsupported PASS verdicts with Codex lifecycle hooks plus CI re-checks.
defaultPrompt: Create an acceptance contract and evals for this feature.
Verify this feature with evidence-backed acceptance gates.
